sections.heading: About Collabrate
sections.headline: One team, every part of your digital growth.
sections.body: Collabrate is a digital development and marketing company founded in 2025, working with businesses across India, Singapore, Malaysia, and the Gulf. We were built on a simple idea: businesses shouldn't have to manage separate vendors for development and marketing. Our team handles both, so what we build is designed to perform, and what we market is backed by something solid.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email, company name, and project details, when you submit a contact form, book a call, or communicate with us. We may also collect basic usage data (such as pages visited or general location) through standard website analytics tools.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information you provide to respond to inquiries, prepare quotes, deliver services, and communicate about your project. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
sections.body: We may use third-party tools (such as scheduling platforms, analytics providers, or email services) to operate our website and business. These providers process data according to their own privacy policies.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: We retain your information only as long as necessary to fulfill the purpose it was collected for, or as required by law.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting us at hello@collabrate.digital.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: Our website may use cookies to improve functionality and understand site usage. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. Continued use of our website after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For questions about this policy, contact us at hello@collabrate.digital.

sections.heading: Services
sections.body: Collabrate provides web and mobile development, digital marketing, and AI solutions. All engagements are scoped and quoted individually based on client requirements, as outlined in a separate proposal or agreement.

sections.heading: Quotes and Payment
sections.body: Pricing is custom to each project and shared prior to work beginning. Payment terms will be specified in the individual client agreement or invoice.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
sections.body: Upon full payment, clients receive ownership rights to the final deliverables as agreed in the project scope, unless otherwise specified. Collabrate retains the right to showcase completed work in its portfolio, unless a client requests confidentiality.

sections.heading: Client Responsibilities
sections.body: Clients are responsible for providing timely feedback, content, and access needed to complete a project as scheduled.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: Collabrate is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our services or website.

sections.heading: Termination
sections.body: Either party may terminate an ongoing engagement as outlined in the individual service agreement.

sections.heading: Governing Law
sections.body: These terms are governed by applicable law based on the jurisdiction of service delivery.

portfolioProjects.title: Turf Booking Platform
portfolioProjects.problem: A turf facility needed a way for customers to book slots online instead of relying on phone calls, along with a digital presence to showcase the facility.
portfolioProjects.solution: We built a booking website with real-time slot reservation, ticket viewing, a cafe menu, and WhatsApp support integration, along with food delivery platform listings.
portfolioProjects.outcome: Customers can now book and manage turf sessions entirely online, with a streamlined experience across booking, tickets, and food ordering.

portfolioProjects.title: HR & Recruitment Dashboard
portfolioProjects.problem: Managing job postings, applicants, and hiring workflows manually was slowing down the recruitment process.
portfolioProjects.solution: We built a dashboard to centralize job listings, applicant tracking, and hiring workflows in one place.
portfolioProjects.outcome: A faster, more organized recruitment process with less manual coordination.

portfolioProjects.title: Enterprise Software Business Website
portfolioProjects.problem: An enterprise software company needed a professional website to represent their AI-driven platform to clients in banking, insurance, and telecom.
portfolioProjects.solution: We built a business website that clearly communicates their methodology and product suite to a technical, enterprise audience.
portfolioProjects.outcome: A polished digital presence that supports credibility in enterprise sales conversations.

portfolioProjects.title: Gym Trainer App
portfolioProjects.problem: Gym trainers needed a way to manage client schedules, track progress, and stay connected with clients outside the gym.
portfolioProjects.solution: We built an Android application connecting trainers and clients around scheduling and engagement.
portfolioProjects.outcome: A more organized way for trainers to manage client relationships digitally.

portfolioProjects.title: Dairy Vendor Management App
portfolioProjects.problem: Coordinating vendors, orders, and delivery for dairy distribution was being handled manually, creating inefficiencies.
portfolioProjects.solution: We built a vendor management app to organize orders, delivery, and vendor coordination.
portfolioProjects.outcome: Smoother day-to-day operations for dairy distribution.

portfolioProjects.title: Dairy Vendor Management App (2)
portfolioProjects.problem: A second dairy distribution business needed a digital system to manage vendor and delivery operations instead of manual tracking.
portfolioProjects.solution: We built a dedicated vendor management app suited to their distribution workflow.
portfolioProjects.outcome: Improved coordination and reduced manual tracking for vendor operations.
